subject: Suppress valgrind for BIO jobs (#3277)
reason: The change is Valgrind test-tooling only: it removes the current_job field that existed solely to keep in-flight BIO jobs reachable for memcheck after thread cancellation, factors the identical zmalloc call into a noinline allocBioJob wrapper so its frame can be matched, and adds a matching suppression to src/valgrind.sup. The allocated size, job contents, submission, processing and freeing of BIO jobs are byte-for-byte the same as before, so there is no observable behaviour change in replies, persistence, replication or memory handling for a fuzzer scenario to reach; the suppression file only
